## Summary

Describe the change and why it matters.

## Type Of Change

- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Refactor
- [ ] Tests
- [ ] Security or governance

## Validation

List the checks you ran.

## Public Impact

Describe changes to commands, formats, APIs, documentation, concepts or user
workflows.

## Risk Notes

Describe risks, limitations, migration concerns or follow-up work.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is scoped and reviewable.
- [ ] Tests or validation notes are included.
- [ ] Documentation is updated when public behavior changes.
- [ ] No secrets, credentials or generated build outputs are committed.
- [ ] Authorship is attributed to responsible human contributors.
